cause.summary: The semantic submit contract required canonical program and subtree SHA-256 preconditions that were neither present in the initial subject context nor computable through an exposed tool.
details: The context manifest exposed a byte-level file digest that differed from the canonical JSON program digest required by semantic_patch_submit.
Expected subtree digests were excluded with reference material and no context inspection operation returned them.
The only discovery path was rejection feedback, which consumed the three-attempt mutation budget.
The source patch contract required no equivalent cryptographic precondition discovery.

next_protocol_requirements: Expose opaque canonical state and subtree precondition tokens through the read-only context protocol.
Do not require the model to calculate or guess cryptographic digests.
Do not consume mutation budget when obtaining immutable concurrency preconditions.
Use new fresh exact task instances before another paired representation claim.
interpretation: Calibration 002 is a valid execution of the frozen v1 protocol and a valid infrastructure observation. Its raw outcomes describe that protocol, but they do not isolate semantic representation quality from missing treatment-specific precondition affordances.
